scenarios.name: merge-quarterly-reports
scenarios.rationale: Response B provides a complete, runnable script that validates input files, merges them with PdfWriter.append(), and reports output page count and file size; Response A only offers three unexecuted suggestions and asks the user to choose, providing no validation or reporting; both responses omit individual input file page count reporting.

scenarios.name: extract-specific-pages
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully reports extracted pages using 1-based numbering (critical rubric requirement) and creates the PDF, but hard-codes the page list instead of parsing the format. Response B Option 1 elegantly parses the format string directly via Ghostscript but provides zero reporting of which pages were extracted (fails explicit rubric requirement); Option 2 replicates Response A's approach without its reporting benefits. Response A better satisfies the reporting requirement despite less elegant parsing.

scenarios.name: split-textbook-into-chapters
scenarios.rationale: Response B fulfills the rubric's explicit requirement to report page counts for each output file; Response A provides working approaches but completely omits page count reporting and result verification.
